title: Guide on Personal Information Processing for the Development and Use of Generative AI
title_original: 생성형 인공지능(AI) 개발·활용을 위한 개인정보 처리 안내서
summary: Guidance published by the Personal Information Protection Commission on 6 August 2025 on applying the Personal Information Protection Act to generative AI. It splits the AI lifecycle into four stages: purpose setting, strategy planning, training and development, and deployment and management. For each stage it sets out the legal bases for using personal data, risk-reduction measures for different development approaches (API use of commercial models, fine-tuning open models, in-house models), and protections for data subjects' rights. It recommends governance led by the Chief Privacy Officer and covers AI agents and machine unlearning. It is guidance, not a binding rule.
key_obligations: Define the AI system's purpose and identify a lawful basis for training data
Apply layered safeguards against data poisoning and jailbreaking
Protect data subjects' rights during deployment and management
Build privacy governance centred on the Chief Privacy Officer

sources.title: 생성형 인공지능(AI) 개발·활용 위한 개인정보 처리 기준 제시한다
